links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to patient ankle sprain questions (Flesch-Kincaid grade level and reading ease)
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 answers were harder to read than Google Search answers: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level difference 3.2 ± 1.7 (P = 0.0012) and Reading Ease difference 22.2 ± 9.3 (P < 0.0001).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4's answers were more difficult to read based on the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (3.2 ± 1.7, P = 0.0012) and Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease Score (22.2 ± 9.3, P < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of responses to patient questions generated by ChatGPT-4 and Google Gemini compared to Google Search, without testing any specific guardrail or organizational deployment practice.
